visual_goal: Show that the failure patterns form chains, with downstream symptoms such as the suspense swamp tracing back to upstream choices about authority, standards and vendors.
prompt: Plain rounded boxes connected by straight arrows, arranged in three horizontal rows, flowing from left to right. Top row, left to right: 'Permanent Exception', 'Doppelgänger Record', 'Spreadsheet Glue', a murky green pond labeled 'Suspense Swamp', and a box with a small robot labeled 'Nobody's Bot'; one arrow from each of these to the next along the row. Middle row: 'Capability Creep' directly below 'Doppelgänger Record', then 'Point-to-Point Spaghetti' directly below 'Spreadsheet Glue', and 'Audit Archaeology' directly below 'Nobody's Bot'. One arrow from 'Permanent Exception' diagonally down into 'Capability Creep'; one arrow from 'Capability Creep' right into 'Point-to-Point Spaghetti'; one arrow from 'Point-to-Point Spaghetti' straight up into 'Spreadsheet Glue'; one arrow from 'Audit Archaeology' straight up into 'Nobody's Bot'. Bottom row, a separate orange chain: 'Borrowed Roadmap', 'Swiss-Army ERP', 'Customization Concrete', 'Big-Bang Bravado', joined in one straight line by three short arrows. Exactly eleven arrows.
alt: Two river systems of failure patterns: from the Permanent Exception through the Doppelgänger Record, Capability Creep and Point-to-Point Spaghetti into Spreadsheet Glue and the Suspense Swamp, which with Audit Archaeology feeds Nobody's Bot; and from the Borrowed Roadmap through the Swiss-Army ERP and Customization Concrete to Big-Bang Bravado.
